newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish ISS enters Polish cleaning market.
newsitem.headline: Danish ISS enters Polish cleaning market.

text.p: Danish cleaning group International Service System(ISS) said on Wednesday its newly-established Polish subsidiary ISS Cleaning Service secured its first two cleaning contracts in Poland.
It said the contracts involved the cleaning of the Warsaw-based Polish National Theatre and the offices of a Danish engineering company, but gave no details of their value.

ISS said the contracts were part of its expansion drive in former eastern bloc countries in central Europe, which now had a total annual turnover of 109 million crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
